prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1458; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving slowly on a two-lane road in Katy, Texas, when the car in front of me stopped short and I braced for impact. The other vehicle came toward me head-on as it crossed into my lane, and although neither of us was moving fast, the jolt was enough to push my head forward and then back against the seat. My neck tightened right away, and by that evening my lower back had joined in with a dull, constant ache. I have described what happened the same way each time I have spoken with the adjuster, the officer at the scene, and the clinic staff, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this statement so the claim can move forward.
